skill.name: ai-visual-accuracy-check
skill.description: Compares rendered HTML screenshots against original PDF page images using AI visual judgment and produces a scored pass or fail quality gate.
skill.summary: AI-assisted visual QA for PDF-to-HTML conversion accuracy.
skill.author: AbeJitsu

content.value_statement: PDF-to-HTML conversion often fails in layout details that pixel checks miss. This skill guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code through visual comparison, scoring, and pass or fail reporting.
actual_capabilities: Compares original PDF page images with rendered HTML screenshots using visual criteria.
Scores layout match, visual hierarchy, content positioning, and typography.
Produces pass or fail guidance using an 85 percent default threshold.
Documents differences and acceptable web rendering variances.
Supports single-page checks and multi-page chapter spot checks.
limitations: Requires available PDF page images and rendered HTML screenshots.
Depends on AI visual judgment, so results can vary between models.
Does not provide a working renderer or API client implementation.
Should not replace human review for sensitive or high-value publications.

use_cases.title: Validate Converted Book Chapters
use_cases.description: Check whether generated HTML preserves the layout and reading experience of source PDF pages.

use_cases.title: Gate Visual QA Before Release
use_cases.description: Use a clear score threshold to decide whether a chapter can proceed to deployment.

use_cases.title: Diagnose Layout Regressions
use_cases.description: Identify spacing, hierarchy, positioning, or typography differences that need CSS or generation fixes.

prompt_templates.title: Check One Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare this original PDF page image with this rendered HTML screenshot. Give a visual accuracy score and a pass or fail recommendation.

prompt_templates.title: Review A Chapter
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these key PDF pages and HTML screenshots for one chapter. Average the scores and identify layout patterns that need fixes.

prompt_templates.title: Tune A Gate Threshold
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate whether an 85 percent threshold is appropriate for this document type. Explain which visual differences should block release.

prompt_templates.title: Create A Remediation Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare the images, score each criterion, separate acceptable rendering differences from defects, and prioritize fixes for the next HTML generation pass.

output_examples.input: Original PDF page and rendered HTML screenshot for chapter 2.
output_examples.output: Visual accuracy: 92.5 percent. Pass. Layout and hierarchy match, with minor spacing differences that are acceptable.

output_examples.input: Three sampled pages from a multi-page chapter.
output_examples.output: Average score: 87 percent. Pass with review. Opening page is strong, but table alignment should be checked before release.

output_examples.input: Rendered page with table alignment concerns.
output_examples.output: Visual accuracy: 78 percent. Fail. Table columns shift from the source page and reduce readability.

best_practices: Use the same viewport size and fonts when creating every HTML screenshot.
Compare representative pages when a chapter spans many pages.
Review low-confidence or borderline scores before blocking release.
anti_patterns: Do not treat the AI score as a pixel-perfect diff result.
Do not lower the threshold without recording a clear reason.
Do not compare screenshots from different zoom levels or crop settings.

faq.question: Does this skill render HTML itself?
faq.answer: No. The skill describes using a headless browser, but it does not ship renderer code.

faq.question: What score is needed to pass?
faq.answer: The documented default threshold is 85 percent. Teams can choose a different threshold for their workflow.

faq.question: Can it work with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. It is written for multimodal visual review and can guide workflows in those tools.

faq.question: Can it handle multi-page chapters?
faq.answer: Yes. It recommends comparing representative pages and averaging the results for a chapter-level decision.

faq.question: Is this a security scanner?
faq.answer: No. It checks visual accuracy and does not inspect HTML for malicious scripts or unsafe links.

faq.question: What does the final report include?
faq.answer: It includes a visual score, pass or fail recommendation, criterion scores, differences, confidence, and explanatory notes.
